_doc: Hand-supplied replacements for day cells the Registrar publishes malformed. Keyed by term slug, then building abbreviation, then lowercase day name. Every entry MUST carry a `why` that cites evidence on the page itself, never a plausible guess. A record fixed from here is emitted with hoursSource "override" so it can be told apart from a scraped one. When the Registrar corrects a cell, delete the entry rather than leaving it to shadow the real value.
_reported: The malformed cells belong to the Room and Class Scheduling Office. This file exists so one Registrar typo does not block a whole term rebuild, not as a substitute for reporting them.

monday.why: Published as "7am-10" with no am/pm. The same panel publishes Friday as "7am-9pm" and Sunday as "12pm-10pm", so a 10pm close is the building's own evening pattern and 10am would be before its Friday close. The identical bare-number malformation appears on the Summer 2026 page as "7am-5" against a Friday of "7am-5pm", which shows the missing token is the pm suffix rather than a different hour.
